info.text:
The average kid's biggest cost? Housing, not daycare. But if you pay for daycare, it can top housing.

USDA (2017 report): a child born in 2015 costs a middle-income couple $233,610 through age 17. Housing is 29%, food 18%, childcare and school 16%, transportation 15%.
Brookings (2022) redid it in future dollars with higher inflation: $310,605, or about $17,256 a year over 18 years.
Child Care Aware: average US childcare price was $13,184 in 2025.
LendingTree (2026 report): $303,418 over 18 years.

Sources: USDA; Brookings Institution; Child Care Aware of America; LendingTree.
News and education, not financial advice.
